semantic_notes: bfBody, bfCall, and bfRun are macros/named proof terms. bfRun expands to a closureVal call whose binding, frame, body, return, and continuation are handled by supplied operational rules.
planetVals, expectedBetween, planetCodes, planetPosition, and planetExpr are representation/summary equations. Even unused representation equations remain definitions, not domain lemmas.
The three #validCases rules are classified by behavior as operational observation rules, despite forming a finite recurrence, because they rewrite <k> and execute Assert/bfRun.
No rule states an independent algebraic fact or theorem, and no rule was first proved in a bridge-free module and later reused.
